title: MCP list_skills Response
description: Serving-integrity contract U11/R15: `tools/mcp_server.py`'s `list_skills` tool response, built by `_serialize_skills`. U7/R3: the mapped skills for a (country, curriculum, grade) scope, optionally narrowed to one unit_code, each carrying its curriculum-local presentation straight off the mapping row (orchestrator/catalog.py's SkillsResult). An unmatched scope or unit_code returns skills=[], never an error (plan point 6).

unit_code.description: The narrowing filter this result was built with, echoed back verbatim; null when the call didn't narrow to one unit.

terminology_overrides.description: Curriculum-local term substitutions, keyed by the canonical term they replace.
